dedupe_keys.name: deliverable d2 5 open source model for probabilistic human health risk assessment

description: Zhiteneva, Veronika and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented probabilistic HHEA model simulates chemical exposure through drinking-water supply, groundwater remediation, irrigation reuse and nutrient recovery. Bayesian updating combines literature, site and modelled information about treatment removal factors, including mixing and evaporation in process trains. End products include drinking water and lettuce, and some exposure routes are theoretical while others cover the full studied process chain. The primary report is restricted, an earlier report is open, and the named public source repository now redirects to KWB-R/ewex under MIT terms. Current repository naming does not establish an identical release or unrestricted report access. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives restricted access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
